q: The audit compared the repair costs of the northern depot as well as those of the southern depot. Which paraphrase preserves both objects of comparison?
o: It compared repair costs at both depots.
It compared the depots themselves, not their repair costs.
It considered only costs shared by the two depots.
It asked the southern depot to repair the northern one.

exp.trans: 审计比较了北部仓库和南部仓库的维修成本。as well as把后一个并列对象补充到前一个对象上；those of the southern depot中的those替代前面的复数名词costs。
exp.structure: 主干：The audit（主语）+ compared（谓语）+ the repair costs...（宾语）。宾语内部由the repair costs of the northern depot和those of the southern depot并列；those指代repair costs，of短语说明成本属于哪个仓库。
exp.other: audit审计；depot仓库/站点；repair cost维修成本；preserve保留。
exp.meaning: as well as在句中表示“以及/还有”；those of是名词替代结构，避免重复repair costs。判断并列时要看两个成分在语法和语义上是否对应。
exp.rest: 把仓库本身当比较对象，忽略了句子明确比较的是维修成本；只比较共同成本加入了only和shared的限制；让南部仓库修理北部仓库则凭空增加了维修动作。

target: that of / 比较对象替代
q: The failure rate of older pumps was higher than that of newer models. In this comparison, that of newer models refers to:
o: the age of the newer models
the failure rate of the newer models
the number of older pumps
the repair cost of the older models

exp.trans: 旧型号水泵的故障率高于新型号水泵的故障率。that替代前面的单数名词failure rate。
exp.structure: 比较结构为The failure rate of older pumps（比较对象一）+ was higher than + that of newer models（比较对象二）。that代替failure rate，of newer models限定这一故障率属于新型号。
exp.other: failure rate故障率；pump水泵；model型号；comparison比较。
exp.meaning: that of可替代前面出现的单数名词，避免重复。先确定被替代的名词，再确定of短语所属的对象。
exp.rest: newer models的年龄不是比较的指标；旧水泵的数量没有出现在比较结构中；repair cost是新添的指标，而且对象也不对。

skill: 可能人选、选定与安排流程
q: A hiring panel decided on a likely candidate for a vacant post and asked HR to arrange interviews. Which account is justified?
o: The panel selected a plausible applicant and asked HR to organize interviews.
The panel invented an imaginary applicant to delay the hiring process.
The panel postponed every interview until another vacancy appeared.
The applicant had accepted the post before the panel made a choice.

exp.trans: 招聘小组选定了一名可能合适的岗位人选，并请人力资源部门安排面试。原文支持“选出可能人选并安排面试”，不支持虚构人物或推迟招聘。
exp.structure: A hiring panel是主语，decided on是谓语，a likely candidate是宾语；for a vacant post限定候选人对应的岗位。asked HR to arrange interviews说明后续安排动作。
exp.other: vacant post空缺职位；candidate候选人；plausible看起来合适的；HR人力资源部门。
exp.meaning: likely candidate指可能合适的人选；decide on表示选定；arrange interviews表示安排面试。三个动作构成正常招聘流程。
exp.rest: imaginary applicant把likely误解成虚构并凭空添加拖延动机；postpone表示推迟，与arrange相反；候选人已经接受职位则把面试前的选择流程倒置成已录用。

target: likely site / arrange talks / 未确认结果
skill: 可能性与后续流程边界
q: After comparing flood maps, planners selected a likely site for a clinic and arranged talks with nearby residents. The talks have not yet occurred. Which conclusion is justified?
o: They chose a possible site and arranged talks with residents.
They approved a final site after completing public consultation.
They invented a location to delay the construction work.
They cancelled the clinic because residents opposed it.

exp.trans: 比较洪水地图后，规划人员选定了一个可能的诊所选址，并安排与附近居民会谈；会谈尚未举行。可以确认的是他们选出了一个可能地点并安排讨论，不能说最终选址已批准。
exp.structure: After comparing...交代背景；主句planners selected... and arranged...有两个并列谓语。likely修饰site，说明可能性；The talks have not yet occurred明确后续会谈仍未发生。
exp.other: flood map洪水地图；site地点/选址；consultation协商；approve批准。
exp.meaning: likely site是可能的选址，不等于已经最终确定；arrange talks表示安排会谈，不等于会谈已经完成。
exp.rest: final site和completed consultation把可能性与未发生的会谈升级为已完成事实；invented a location凭空增加虚构动机；cancelled the clinic及居民反对均无文本依据。

q: After marrying into the family that owns the bakery, Mira began helping with its accounts. What does marrying into the family mean?
o: She became part of the family through marriage.
She married every member of the family.
She arranged a marriage for the family.
She rented a room in the family's house.

exp.trans: 嫁入拥有这家面包店的家庭后，Mira开始帮忙处理账目。marry into the family表示通过婚姻成为这个家庭的一员。
exp.structure: After marrying into...是时间状语；主句Mira began helping...。that owns the bakery是修饰family的定语从句。
exp.other: bakery面包店；account账目；become part of成为……的一部分；through marriage通过婚姻。
exp.meaning: marry somebody表示与某人结婚；marry into a family表示通过婚姻进入某个家庭或社会关系。
exp.rest: 不是与家庭每一位成员分别结婚；不是替家庭安排婚事；也不是仅仅租住在家庭的房子里。

q: The relief shipment reached the island by way of a smaller port after the main harbor closed. Here, by way of means:
o: through or via the smaller port
in order to repair the smaller port
because the smaller port had closed
instead of using any port at all

exp.trans: 主要港口关闭后，救援物资经由一个较小的港口抵达岛上。by way of表示经由、通过。
exp.structure: The relief shipment是主语，reached是谓语，the island是宾语；by way of a smaller port说明到达路线。
exp.other: relief shipment救援物资；harbor港口；via经由；close关闭。
exp.meaning: by way of + 地点表示经过某处、经由某处；此处说明路线，不表示目的或原因。
exp.rest: in order to表达目的，原句没有修港口的动作；because表示原因，不能解释到达路线；instead of表示替代，且与物资实际经过小港口相反。

q: After the supervisor demonstrated the procedure, the trainee completed the calibration on his own. Here, on his own means:
o: without help from another person
under the supervisor's direct control
using equipment that belongs to him
because he had no other assignment

exp.trans: 主管演示流程后，实习人员独自完成了校准。on his own表示独自地、没有他人帮助。
exp.structure: After引导时间状语；主句the trainee completed the calibration，on his own补充说明完成动作的方式。
exp.meaning: on one's own常表示独自完成或不依靠他人；这里描述完成校准时的独立状态。
exp.rest: under direct control表示受主管控制，与独自完成相反；设备所有权不是句子重点；没有其他任务也不是on his own的含义。

q: The minister delivered a sermon on forgiveness during the Sunday service. A sermon is:
o: a religious talk given to a congregation
a written list of payments due to a church
a private meeting to arrange a marriage
a short announcement about the weather

exp.trans: 牧师在周日礼拜期间发表了一篇关于宽恕的布道。sermon指布道、宗教讲道。
exp.structure: The minister是主语，delivered是谓语，a sermon是宾语；on forgiveness说明讲道主题，during the Sunday service说明时间场景。
exp.meaning: sermon通常指宗教场合面向会众的讲道，也可引申为带有训诫意味的长篇说教。
exp.rest: 教会应付款清单、安排婚姻的私人会议和天气公告都不符合minister、Sunday service及forgiveness共同构成的宗教语境。

q: Workers were piling empty crates beside the loading bay before the delivery arrived. Piling means:
o: stacking them together in a heap
checking each one for a label
sending them to a distant warehouse
taking them apart for repair

exp.trans: 货物送达前，工人正在装卸区旁把空箱子堆起来。piling在此表示堆放、堆叠。
exp.structure: Workers是主语，were piling是过去进行时谓语，empty crates是宾语；beside the loading bay说明堆放地点。
exp.other: crate板条箱；loading bay装卸区；stack堆叠；delivery送货。
exp.meaning: pile可作动词，表示把物品堆成一堆；具体动作由宾语empty crates和地点beside the loading bay确定。
exp.rest: 检查标签、运往仓库和拆开维修都是其他操作，不能表达把箱子堆在一起。

skill: 同一动词的具体与抽象语境
q: After the booking website failed, complaints began piling up in the customer-service inbox. What does piling up mean here?
o: being deleted one by one
accumulating in increasing numbers
being answered before they arrived
being transferred to another company

exp.trans: 预约网站故障后，客服收件箱里的投诉开始不断累积。piling up在此表示数量越来越多。
exp.structure: complaints是主语，began piling up是谓语结构；in the customer-service inbox说明累积的位置。
exp.other: booking website预约网站；complaint投诉；accumulate累积；inbox收件箱。
exp.meaning: pile up既可指把实体物品堆叠起来，也可引申为问题、工作或投诉数量不断累积；这里不是把投诉作为实体搬动。
exp.rest: 删除、提前答复和转交给其他公司都不是数量持续增加的意思。

q: During a field inspection, a technician fastened a thin cord around the sensor housing by making a knot. The team then handed a calibration weight from one person to the next. Which pair describes the actions?
o: wrapped the cord / carried the weight
tied the cord / passed the weight
passed the cord / tied the weight
lit the cord / wrapped the weight

exp.trans: 现场检查时，技术员打结把细绳系在传感器外壳上；随后团队成员把校准砝码从一人手中传到下一人手中。对应动作是tie和pass。
exp.structure: 第一句technician fastened...by making a knot，by短语明确系绳方式是打结；第二句the team handed...from one person to the next，明确物体在人与人之间转交。
exp.other: field inspection现场检查；sensor housing传感器外壳；calibration weight校准砝码；knot结。
exp.meaning: tie表示系住、打结；pass something from one person to the next表示把东西传递给下一个人。要识别动作的结果和路径。
exp.rest: wrap表示包裹或缠绕，未必形成固定的结；carry表示携带而非交到下一人手中；pass the cord / tie the weight把两个动作对象对调；light和wrap都不符合句中动作。

skill: 包裹与打结的动作区别
q: Before shipping a glass instrument, a clerk covered it with protective cloth, folding the cloth around the case in several layers. No knot or fastening was used. Which paraphrase best describes the action?
o: wrapped the case in protective cloth
tied the cloth tightly around the case
passed the cloth to a colleague nearby
lit the cloth with a match

exp.trans: 发运玻璃仪器前，工作人员用防护布包住仪器，把布一层层折叠在外壳周围；没有打结或固定。动作是包裹。
exp.structure: a clerk covered it...是主干；folding the cloth around the case补充包裹方式；No knot or fastening was used排除了打结固定。
exp.other: protective cloth防护布；case外壳；layer层；fastening固定件/固定动作。
exp.meaning: wrap强调用材料包住或缠绕物体；tie强调用绳带系住，常包含打结或固定。此处布料覆盖并折叠，没有系结。
exp.rest: tie要求系住/固定的动作，题干明确说没有knot或fastening；pass表示传递；light表示点燃，均不符合包裹仪器的场景。

q: At a camp safety drill, one camper handed a lantern from the first person to the last; another lit a stove after the group had settled. Which pair describes the actions?
o: lit the lantern / passed the stove
passed the lantern / lit the stove
wrapped the lantern / tied the stove
tied the lantern / wrapped the stove

exp.trans: 营地安全演练中，一名露营者把灯笼从队伍第一个人传到最后一个人；另一人等大家安顿后点燃了炉子。动作分别是传递灯笼和点燃炉子。
exp.structure: one camper handed a lantern...是第一项动作；from the first person to the last给出传递路径。another lit a stove是第二项动作，after从句说明时间。
exp.other: camp safety drill营地安全演练；lantern灯笼；stove炉子；settle安顿下来。
exp.meaning: pass表示把物品从一个人交给另一个人；light表示点燃。要把动词与其实际宾语及动作路径配对。
exp.rest: 把lit和passed的对象对调；wrap和tie表示包裹/系绑，不符合手递手传灯笼或点燃炉子的动作。

q: The archivist kept the fragile maps in a sealed cabinet ___ humidity fell below the safe limit, ___ the digitization team continued scanning copies in the next room. Choose the best pair.
o: until / whereas
whereas / until
although / because
because / although

exp.trans: 湿度降到安全范围以下之前，档案管理员一直把易损地图放在密封柜里；与此同时，数字化团队则在隔壁继续扫描副本。
exp.structure: 第一空连接kept...与humidity fell，表示保存状态持续到某个时间点；第二空连接两组同时发生但不同的安排，表示对比。
exp.other: archivist档案管理员；fragile易损的；sealed密封的；digitization数字化。
exp.meaning: until表示直到某个时间点为止；whereas表示而/然而，用于对照两个主体或情况。时间终点不能用对比连词替代。
exp.rest: whereas不能表达第一分句持续到湿度下降这一时间终点；until不适合第二空的两种安排对比；although表示让步，because表示原因，都不符合两处关系。

skill: 上限与必须达到的时长
q: Residents may borrow a portable generator for up to ten days; they can return it earlier. What does up to ten days mean?
o: Ten days is the maximum period, not a required stay.
Every borrower must keep it for exactly ten days.
Borrowers may keep it for more than ten days.
The generator can only be used on the tenth day.

exp.trans: 居民最多可以借用便携式发电机十天，也可以提前归还。up to ten days表示最长十天。
exp.structure: may borrow表达许可；for up to ten days限定允许借用的最长时长；they can return it earlier进一步说明不要求用满十天。
exp.other: portable便携式；generator发电机；maximum最大值；earlier更早地。
exp.meaning: up to + 数量/时长表示上限，不表示必须达到该数量或持续完整时段。
exp.rest: exactly ten days把上限改成固定时长；more than ten days超过了明示上限；only on the tenth day把持续时间误解成某一天的使用许可。

target: whatever + 名词 / 嵌入式修饰结构
skill: 名词短语内部结构与主句宾语
q: The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain whatever equipment they brought for the project. Which analysis is accurate?
o: The phrase is the subject of lets and refers to the researcher.
The whole phrase is the object of retain; whatever determines equipment.
The phrase is a direct question asking what equipment was brought.
The phrase modifies workshop and explains why the visit occurred.

exp.trans: 工作坊允许每位来访研究人员保留自己为项目带来的任何设备。whatever equipment they brought for the project整体作retain的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句骨架：The workshop lets each visiting researcher retain something。whatever equipment they brought for the project替换something，整体是retain的宾语；whatever限定equipment，they brought for the project修饰equipment。
exp.other: workshop工作坊；visiting researcher来访研究人员；retain保留；equipment设备。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词可表示“任何……/所……的任何东西”。先识别整个名词短语在主句中的位置，再分析短语内部的限定词和修饰从句。
exp.rest: 主句主语是The workshop，不是whatever短语；这里不是直接疑问句；whatever短语不修饰workshop，也不说明访问原因。

target: whatever + 名词 / 整体作宾语
skill: 名词性结构与从句内部关系
q: The registrar will accept whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday. What role does the underlined phrase play?
o: It is the object of accept: any documents the applicant submits.
It is the subject of submits and refers to the registrar.
It asks which documents the applicant may submit.
It modifies Friday and explains the reason for the deadline.

exp.trans: 登记员会接受申请人在周五之前提交的任何文件。whatever documents the applicant submits整体作accept的宾语。
exp.structure: 主句：The registrar will accept something。whatever documents the applicant submits before Friday整体替代something，作accept的宾语；the applicant submits是修饰documents的限定性关系结构，documents是submits的宾语。
exp.other: registrar登记员；applicant申请人；submit提交；deadline截止时间。
exp.meaning: whatever + 名词表示任何符合后续限定的该类事物；整个短语可以在主句中作宾语。要区分外层动词accept与内层从句谓语submits。
exp.rest: underlined phrase不是submits的主语，内层主语是the applicant；这不是直接疑问句；Friday是before的宾语，不是被whatever短语修饰的对象，也没有说明截止原因。

target: as well as / 附加范围
q: Access to the laboratory is granted to visiting researchers as well as to permanent staff. Which statement follows?
o: Both groups may receive laboratory access.
Only permanent staff may enter the laboratory.
Visiting researchers replace permanent staff.
Only researchers with permanent contracts may apply.

exp.trans: 实验室既向来访研究人员开放，也向正式员工开放。as well as把第二类适用对象补充到第一类对象上。
exp.structure: Access is granted to A as well as to B；两个to短语处于并列层级，分别表示获得访问权限的两类人。
exp.other: access访问权限；visiting researcher来访研究人员；permanent staff正式员工；grant给予。
exp.meaning: as well as表示“以及/也包括”，在这里扩展规则适用对象，并不排除前一个对象。
exp.rest: only把规则缩小到正式员工；replace把补充关系改成替代关系；permanent contracts是原文没有提出的额外条件。
